verdict.rationale: Temporal is explicitly 'Workflows-as-Code' rather than a no-code engine. Workflows and their Activity steps are written directly in real code through the Python and TypeScript SDKs, which provide APIs for Workflow and Activity execution with automatic retries. Community users confirm the code-first model, noting that workflow code must be deterministic. Missing for 10: an explicit code example showing a JS or Python function defined and run as an Activity step, and clear documentation of the determinism constraints on in-workflow code versus Activities.
